Ankit Tiwari (born 1 August 1992) is an Indian Village Level Entrepreneur (VLE) associated with CSC e‑Governance Services India Limited. He works in the delivery of digital public services, including government documentation, welfare enrolment, and online citizen services in rural areas of Uttar Pradesh.
Early life and education
Tiwari was born on 1 August 1992 in Shikohabad, Uttar Pradesh. He completed his schooling under the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) in 2008 (Class 10) and 2010 (Class 12). He earned a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Food Technology from Bundelkhand University in 2014 and a Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) from the Exam Regulatory Authority, Uttar Pradesh, in 2019.
Career
CSC e‑Governance Services India Limited (2017–present)
Tiwari has worked as a Village Level Entrepreneur since 2017, providing digital governance services such as certificate issuance, welfare programme enrolment, and identity-related services in rural areas.
Food technology and production roles
Before joining CSC, Tiwari worked in food production and quality roles at several organisations, including:
* Senior Executive – Production, The Akshaya Patra Foundation (2016)
* Unit Head, INBISCO India Pvt. Ltd (2016)
* Production Executive, Makson Health Care Pvt. Ltd (2014–2015)
* Quality and production trainee positions at Wave Distilleries & Breweries, Mondelēz International, Hamdard Laboratories, Edward Food Research & Analysis Centre, and Mother Dairy
Skills and training
Tiwari has completed professional training programmes in digital services, food safety systems, elementary education, cyber security, and optical fibre splicing.
Honors
Tiwari has participated in academic seminars, including the National Seminar on Advances in Bioprocesses for Environmental Safety and Nutritional Security.
Personal life
Tiwari speaks Hindi and English and resides in Shikohabad, Uttar Pradesh.
